title: Odile and the Extraction
author: Cyrus Ishikawa
blurb: Quentin Sterling, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
